title: Expensive Expense
constraintsSummary: Time limit: 4 sec; Memory limit: 1024 MiB; Constraints: 2 \leq N \leq 2 \times 10^5; 1 \leq A_i \leq N (1 \leq i \leq N-1); 1 \leq B_i \leq N (1 \leq i \leq N-1); 1 \leq C_i \leq 10^9 (1 \leq i \leq N-1); 1 \leq D_i \leq 10^9 (1 \leq i \leq N); It is possible to travel from Town i to Town j via some number of roads, for a pair of integers (i,j) such that 1 \leq i \lt j \leq N.; All values in input are integers.
